name: 3D Surface Splatting
definition: 3DSS is a differentiable surface splatting renderer for physically-based inverse rendering that jointly recovers geometry, materials, and illumination from multi-view images by optimizing an unstructured set of oriented surfel primitives.
summary: 3D Surface Splatting is a differentiable renderer that recovers geometry and materials from multi-view images using oriented surfel primitives and interval-merging to handle multiple surface layers per pixel.
